GoverningSphereSpec.Label: Dream
GoverningSphereSpec.Description: A direction for my dreams; or a trouble to recover from.

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: Dream
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: Rest; reconsider your priorities; or risk yourself in exploration of the kingdoms of sleep.

GoverningSphereSpec.Label: Study
GoverningSphereSpec.Description: The invisible arts could occupy ten lifetimes of study.

GoverningSphereSpec.Label: Expenses
GoverningSphereSpec.Description: The shop-keepers will have their due. I must pay it or starve.

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: Time Passes
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: Time, the sundial's shadow, passes. I must have Funds to live, or I will become ill.

GoverningSphereSpec.Label: Talk
GoverningSphereSpec.Description: An ally, an enemy, or something in between.

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: Discuss occult business with a Follower
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: Significant conversations in a smoky meeting-room. What do I need from my follower? [Add your cult, to send them out on cult business; send them after enemies; or raise another matter.]

GoverningSphereSpec.Label: Explore
GoverningSphereSpec.Description: A place; a person; a location; a secret.

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: Explore
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: Explore the city with Health or Followers; explore locations; or investigate the possibilities of lore. Exploration is often unpredictable.

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: Bleak Thoughts
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: Dark days. I must be careful not to let doubts creep in. [Dread may provoke full-fledged Despair.]

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: DESPAIR
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: Despair is the wolf that devours thought. [You can defeat Despair by feeding it Contentment; otherwise, it will destroy you when it reaches 3 Dread.]

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: The Wrong Kind of Attention
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: The city is rife with journalists and detectives and other meddlers. How long will they leave me in peace?

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: The Wrong Kind of Attention
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: I'm safe for now. The meddlers' attention must be elsewhere. A relief.

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: The Curious Few
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: The wrong kind of reputation might awaken the interest of the curious, the puritanical, or the vengeful. [A Reputation may inspire an adversary to emerge.]

GoverningSphereSpec.Label: Diligence
GoverningSphereSpec.Description: Extra effort. It might help, sometimes.

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: Junior Work at Glover & Glover
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: The scratching of pens, the sourness of dust, the sighing of the younger Glover, the greedy gurgling of the elder.

Illuminations.tlg.notes.title: Extra Effort at Glover & Glover
Illuminations.tlg.notes.description: I will apply extra effort. Perhaps they'll appreciate it.
